data.current_summary: Tool-definition transparency log: signed tree head
data.current_description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated. The current signed tree head of the tool-definition log. Pin it over time to confirm the log only ever grows.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve current tool-definition log signed tree head
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves the current signed tree head (SignedTreeHead) of the tool-definition transparency log. This endpoint is public and requires no authentication. The signed tree head represents a cryptographic commitment to all tool definitions logged up to this point. Clients should pin this value over time to verify the log's append-only property and detect any unauthorized modifications. Returns a SignedTreeHead object containing the Ed25519 signature, tree size, and other chain-of-custody fields.
